name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.shopeepay.payment.ShopeePayPaymentActivity
description: When a user selects ShopeePay wallet payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen opens ShopeePay for authorization when available or displays the QR payment route.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with ShopeePay wallet payments.
